passive_skill.desc:
Increase Attack by 29.1%.
When an ally activates a skill, gain 1 Shark's Blade stack. Stacks up to 5 times. Also, when Resonance is activated, gain 1 Serrated Shark's Blade stack. Stacks up to 5 times. These effects activate even in reserve.
With 5 Shark's Blade stacks, when the user activates a skill on foes, spend all Shark's Blade and Serrated Shark's Blade stacks to increase all foes' damage taken by 1% per stack spent for 1 turn.
